In a certain code language, 'TYR' is coded as '65', and 'GAP' is coded as '26'. How will 'MOJ' be coded in that language?

एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'TYR' को '65' के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है और 'GAP' को '26' के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो समान भाषा में 'MOJ' को किस प्रकार कोडित किया जायेगा?
questions.s:
The code is by adding the position of all the alphabets according to the alphabetical series and '2' to the total sum.

TYR = (20+25+18) + 2 = 63+2 = 65

GAP = (7+1+16) + 2 = 24+2 = 26

Similarly,

MOJ = (13+15+10) + 2 = 38+2 = 40

So, 'MOJ' will be coded as '40'.

“dreams are many” is coded as “zsx njm ytr”------------(iii)

“confused so are” is coded as  “kol zsx drf”--------------(iv)

From equations (i) and (iii), we get that,

many → njm

From equations (i) and (iv), we get that,

so → drf

From equation (i), we get that,

mornings → aws

From equation (ii), we get that,

Woke/up → cfv/bhn

From equations (ii) and (iv), we get that,

confused → kol

From equations (iii) and (iv), we get that,

are → zsx

From equations (iv), we get that,

Dreams → ytr

The code for “up” is either “cfv/bhn” and “side” code must be unique.
